gap_details.2011-2012: SIGNIFICANT. No roster capture. kyneurosurgery.com first captured 2012-05-30 (home); houseStaffRoster.html first captured 2013-03-03. Other 2012 captures (residencyInformation.html 2012-06-01, clinicalFaculty, medicalStudents) carry no names. ukhealthcare.uky.edu 2011-12 KNI pages have no resident list. Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 (only crawl in 2011-12 window): 0 records for kyneurosurgery.com, 4 non-roster records for ukhealthcare.uky.edu/kni. Not reconstructed: no 2010-11 roster to bracket against. The 2011 interns (Smith, Timoney) and all 2012-13 residents were present, but anyone who left during 2011-12 is invisible. PHASE 2: gapaudit 2011-15 over kyneurosurgery.com, www.mc.uky.edu/gme, med.uky.edu/house-staff, med.uky.edu/affiliations, ukhealthcare.uky.edu/kni found no roster; PubMed affiliation mining 2010-16 found no unlisted resident. Significance LOW: 2011 class = 2 = complement, both present in 2012-13.
gap_details.2012-2013: SIGNIFICANT (incomplete). Mar 2013 capture only (spring). Page headings run PGY-1..PGY-6 only although the program was 7 years (curriculum lists sixth and seventh year); the 2006 entrant PGY-7 class, if any, is not listed. Asfahani listed PGY-6 here and again in 2013-14.
gap_details.2013-2014: SIGNIFICANT (incomplete). Sep 2013 capture. PGY-7 not displayed (headings PGY-1..6): Hughes and Davis (PGY-6 in 2012-13) would be PGY-7 and are absent. Asfahani listed PGY-6 again (either a repeated year or a 2008 entrant mislabelled in 2012-13; NPI enumerated Nov 2008).
gap_details.2014-2015: SIGNIFICANT (incomplete). Oct 2014 capture (Feb 2015 identical names). Still no PGY-7 heading: Brown and Asfahani (PGY-6 in 2013-14) absent. Marasa (PGY-2 2013-14) and Stafford (PGY-4 2013-14) absent: departures. PHASE 2: CC-MAIN-2014-23 capture 2014-07-25 (already listing 2014 interns Hall/Snyder and omitting Marasa) still showed Stafford as PGY-5; he is gone from 2014-08-22 onward.
gap_details.2015-2016: Aug 2015; first version with a PGY-7 heading (Mannas, Grupke).
gap_details.2016-2017: Aug 2016 capture (unchanged through Jun 2017 per Common Crawl). Mannas and Grupke still printed under PGY-7 alongside Khoury (chief): they were PGY-7 in 2015-16 and entered 2009, so this is carry-over (or a post-residency fellowship year; Grupke later UK faculty). Excluded from 2016-17 rows.

gap_details.2019-2020: Only capture is 2020-07-05 (July), content-dated 2019-20 (Lamm/Dillen PGY-7; 2019 interns PGY-1). Complete list.
gap_details.2021-2022: 2021-07-28 capture, content-dated 2021-22 (2021 interns Choi/Skidmore PGY-1). Last archived roster on neurosurgery.med.uky.edu; the 2022 intern class is not seen until the May 2023 medicine.uky.edu capture.

2011-2012.reason: No roster anywhere (Wayback, CC-MAIN-2012, GME/med hosts). Only 2011+ entrants in the year were the 2011 interns; program 'accepts two residents per year' (applicationProcess 2013) and both (Smith, Timoney) are on the 2012-13 roster, so no 2011+ entrant could leave unseen. Only pre-2011 departures during 2011-12 would be invisible.

2012-2013.reason: PGY-7 (2006 entrants) never displayed on any page (roster, group-photo caption, faculty page). All 2011+ entrants fully visible; CC 2013-05 identical.

2013-2014.reason: PGY-7 (Hughes, Davis) hidden. All 2011+ classes complete; CC 2013-12 and 2014-03/04 identical.

2014-2015.reason: PGY-7 (Brown, Asfahani) hidden; all 2011+ classes complete. CC 2014-07-25 shows transitional update (Stafford PGY-5), CC 2014-08..2015-08 identical to Oct 2014 list.

2016-2017.reason: Complete PGY-1..7 list (2016-17: Mannas/Grupke carry-over excluded)

terminal_pgy_note: Program was 7 years throughout (applicationProcess 2013: 'seven-years of clinical training and accepts two residents per year'). The 2012-15 site simply never displayed the PGY-7 year, so for the 2007 and 2008 entrants (Hughes, Davis, Asfahani, Brown) PGY-6 is the last OBSERVABLE year; do not count them as departures.
